latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video to Text Converter Online.

- Convert video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) into transcribed text or subtitles.
- Supports journalists, students, and content creators with cloud GPU-based speech-to-text processing.
- Connection and session established via NEMO_TOKEN or free starter token for up to 100 credits.
- Easy upload, fast (30–90 seconds) cloud transcription, and 1080p MP4 output.
- Provides status handling, error reporting, and session-based workflow for multiple files.
